text.text_excerpt: We first heard about French Quarter Suites through friends who booked with them in the past. We'd been told it was a good location, relative to the French Quarter and the bustlings of Bourbon Street. And for those looking to get to Bourbon street this is but 3 blocks away, and from Decatur merely another 3-4 blocks of walk. So it's incredibly convenient. After a few email exchanges with the staff, I moved to phone communication and met likely the best person in the hospitality industry - Dennis. One of the front of house staff at the Hotel and it's connected properties, Dennis worked tirelessly to ensure our every need was met, every stitch of information we required, every booking we nee...

We stayed here a few weeks ago for six nights and had a great experience. The place is located just a ten minute walk from Bourbon St/Frenchman St (depending on which is your adventure), 15 minutes from Cafe Du Monde. We never had to take a cab and felt perfectly safe walking home at night. On our last day there we realized there were some bars on the outskirts of the French Quarter that more of the locals go to (you can see my reviews of those later!) and were happy to check those out too. Continental Breakfast was scarce with a variety of toasts, spreads, fruits, waffle maker and coffee - but it got the job done for what I need in the morning. As we walked up to the hotel we were greeted by friendly staff. We are checked in quickly find more friendly staff. Up on checking into our room we found it to be quaint but to our liking. The price the service the ambience the courtyard the location all make this the prime spot for a nice peaceful exciting and enjoyable weekend in new orleans.
